text: Columbina Theme — Patch Edition 是面向 DSH Web 的哥伦比娅主题插件，提供银蓝渐变、毛玻璃效果与人格设定编辑。客户端注入主题样式，并在侧栏和设置页提供编辑入口；宿主端挂载人格提示并保存设定。用户可以上传背景图、调整模糊和清晰度、管理贴图，以及编辑欢迎页标题和正文。适合希望定制 DSH Web 外观与对话人格的用户；无需额外 API 密钥，设定保存在本机 DSH_HOME 中。

Columbina Theme is a silver-blue glass style for DSH Web with editable persona settings. It adds theme controls in the sidebar and settings, saves persona locally, and supports background uploads, blur and clarity controls, stickers, and a customizable welcome screen. No API key is required.

Columbina Theme 的功能「背景图控制」：用户可从设置上传背景图，并调整模糊、清晰度、轮换与间隔。 通过设置页操作并保存。
Columbina Theme 的功能「欢迎页编辑」：用户可编辑新会话欢迎页标题和正文，并设置欢迎形象。 通过设置页操作并保存。
Columbina Theme 的功能「主题与人格设定」：侧栏和设置页提供人格编辑；保存后宿主更新系统提示中的人格 section。 通过设置页操作并保存。
Columbina Theme 的功能「贴图管理」：插件提供贴图开关与管理入口，客户端通过宿主路由读取贴图清单及图片。 通过设置页操作并保存。

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Columbina Theme — Patch Edition：[**English**](README.md) | [**中文**](README.zh-CN.md)

A moonlit silver-blue glassmorphism skin for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, with an editable Columbina persona.

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Columbina Theme — Patch Edition：**This is a patch, not an original theme.** The bulk of the code comes from [Columbina-sn](https://github.com/Columbina-sn/dsh-columbina-theme), the font palette from [hyposelen1a](https://github.com/hyposelen1a/dsh-columbina-theme), and the host/client structure from [berhbro](https://github.com/berhbro/dsh-cyrene-theme). See [Credits](#credits).
dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Disclaimer：This theme is pure CSS rendered by your browser, so the final look depends on your machine:

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Disclaimer：- **Glass blur** (`backdrop-filter`) needs Chromium 76+ / Edge / Chrome. Old engines, disabled hardware acceleration, some remote desktops, VMs or integrated-GPU drivers fall back to a flat translucent layer — no blur.
- **Gradient text** (`background-clip:text`) may fail to paint on a few GPU drivers. There is a `@supports` solid-colour fallback, but it looks different.
- **Light/dark** follows your system/Harness appearance (`prefers-color-scheme` and `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`), not a plugin switch.
- **High DPI** (125% / 150% / 200%) changes how the 72px avatar, 1px borders and 2px letter-spacing read; screenshot pixels are not CSS pixels.
- **Wide-gamut displays / colour management** make saturated purples such as `#78007a` look brighter or duller. The "same colour" never is, across screens.
- **Fonts**: the hero title prefers Source Han Serif / STSong and falls back to a system serif, which changes metrics.
- **Host wallpaper overlay**: if your Harness frontend ships its own full-screen wallpaper layer (e.g. `#dsh-wall-layer`, opaque, `z-index:0`), it paints over this theme's `z-index:-1` background layer. Since v0.2.2 the theme hide
dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Disclaimer：Screenshots are illustrative, not a guarantee of pixel-identical rendering.

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · What it is：A DSH theme plugin: palette, background image, glass effects, editable persona and sticker conventions.
This patched edition adds a theme-takeover switch, background upload, blur/clarity sliders and an editable hero title.

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · What's changed：| Change | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| **Theme takeover** | When two Columbina themes are installed they fight over the same tokens. Toggle on → the other package (`dsh-columbina-theme`) is disabled through the host `pluginManager`; toggle off → it is restored and this theme steps aside. Persisted across restarts. |
| **Background upload** | Upload from the panel; files land in `Background/` and become the anchor. Hover `×` on a thumbnail to delete (with confirm). Never overwrites existing files, duplicates get a suffix. |
| **Blur & clarity** | Two independent sliders: blur 0–40px (preview while dragging, persist on release; the layer scales by `1 + radius/200` to hide the soft edge) and clarity, the positive phrasing of the veil opacity. |
| **Editable hero title** | The title lives in the state file and is editable from the panel. Empty `hero.image` hides the avatar entirely, leaving one line of text. |
| **Editable welcome page** | Title and a multi-line body are both editable from the panel (v0.3.0). An empty body renders nothing at all; an empty title falls back to the built-in line. |
| **Font palette** | Label tokens now use hypose
dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · What's changed：Everything else (persona section, sticker manifest, fenced routes, slot registration, glass CSS) is unchanged from upstream.

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Install：Requirements: a DSH desktop or web profile that loads client plugins. Verified on **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**; the Linux test also passed on **0.2.0-rc.2**.

`dsh plugin` needs **pnpm** on PATH. If it fails with `spawn pnpm ENOENT`, run `corepack enable pnpm` first.

From GitHub:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Columbla/dsh-columbina-theme-sn
```

From a local folder:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\path\to\dsh-columbina-theme-sn
```

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Install：Refresh the page afterwards (the client half is read on page load). Host-half changes need a plugin row reload or a DSH restart.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-columbina-theme-sn
```

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Quick start：1. A `☾ 哥伦比娅` button appears next to Settings at the sidebar foot; the same editor is also under Settings → 哥伦比娅 · 主题.
2. Top switches: persona / skin / **theme takeover** / stickers / proactive stickers / no-repeat.
3. Background block: upload, pick an anchor, drag blur and clarity.
4. `恢复默认` refills the default persona draft; `重新载入` discards unsaved edits.

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · When changes apply：| What | Applies |
| --- | --- |
| Persona / switches / background settings (panel save) | Immediately, next turn |
| `lib/client.js` | Page refresh |
| `lib/index.js`, `cordis.patch.yml` | Plugin row reload or restart |
| `Background/` add / remove / rename | Page refresh |

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · State & settings：The state file lives at `$DSH_HOME/columbina-theme.json`, or `~/.dsh/columbina-theme.json` when `DSH_HOME` is unset.

```json
{
  "persona": "…persona prompt…",
  "enabled": true,
  "theme": true,

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · State & settings：| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `persona` | Persona prompt; empty disables injection |
| `enabled` / `theme` | Persona switch / skin switch |
| `takeover` | `true` disables the rival theme |
| `stickers` / `proactive` / `noRepeat` | Sticker switches — prompt rules only, not message filters |
| `stickerSize` | Max sticker edge, 48–320px |
| `customStickers` / `stickerOverrides` | User-added entries / renames and hiding of bundled ones |
| `hero.image` | In-package relative path; **empty hides the avatar** |
| `hero.title` | The hero line |
| `hero.body` | Multi-line text under the title, rendered with `white-space: pre-wrap` (max 2000 chars); empty hides the whole block |
| `background.dim` | Veil opacity 0–0.95, higher is paler; the panel's "clarity" = `1 - dim` |
| `background.blur` | Blur radius 0–40px |
| `rev` | Write revision; bump it when editing by hand |
dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · State & settings：Writes go through a temp file + rename and carry optimistic concurrency: missing `rev` → 400 `client-outdated`, stale → 409 `stale`.

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Theme takeover：Both packages override `--dsw-alias-*` and paint their own background layer, so only one can win. This fork does not fight over CSS specificity:

```js
const RIVAL_PACKAGE = 'dsh-columbina-theme'          // the other package
const manager = ctx.get('pluginManager')
await manager.setPluginEnabled(rival.entryId, !takeover)
```

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Theme takeover：- On → the rival row is written as `disabled: true` in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (persistent; it will not come back on reboot).
- Off → `disabled: false` is restored and this theme's `theme` flag is turned off too, so you never end up with no theme at all.
- 1.5s after host start, the plugin re-checks `takeover` from the state file.
- If the rival is absent or `pluginManager` is not available, the switch only reports a message — it never breaks the plugin.

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Background & blur：| Control | Range | Field |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Blur | 0–40 px | `background.blur` |
| Clarity | 5–100% | `background.dim = 1 - clarity/100` |
| Interval | 15–600 s | `background.interval` (only with `rotate`) |

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Background & blur：Upload goes through `POST /columbina/backgrounds` (`data:image/*;base64`, ≤ 24MB). File names are stripped of path separators and reserved characters; duplicates get a suffix and existing files are never overwritten. Deletion uses `POST /columbina/backgrounds/remove` and only accepts names present in the scanned list.

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Assets：The repo ships a default asset set so it looks complete out of the box:

| Path | Content |
| --- | --- |
| `meme/` | 12 Columbina stickers (WebP) + an optional hero avatar `星眸.png` (shipped, **not used by default**) |
| `Background/` | 3 presets: `01-columbina-light.png`, `02-columbina-dark.png`, `03-columbina-dusk.jpg` |

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Assets：These images are **not** covered by MIT. Character art and official stickers belong to **miHoYo / HoYoverse**; the avatar and backgrounds belong to their respective artists. Non-commercial fan use only — open an issue and the assets will be removed on request. See [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md).

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Assets：To use your own images: drop them into `Background/` and refresh; name sticker files after `stickers.json`'s `items[].file`; point `hero.image` at any in-package path (a circular PNG with alpha at 72px works best).

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Known issues & fixes：| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hero avatar comes back after a restart | Before the state arrives `heroReady` defaults to `true`, so the browser paints a cached avatar | Fixed: nothing is rendered while `heroKey` is empty |
| Swapped avatar still shows the old image | `/columbina/hero` sends `Cache-Control: max-age=300` | Fixed: the URL carries `?v=<path>` |
| Switching the background image or dragging blur does nothing | The host frontend draws its own opaque wallpaper layer (`#dsh-wall-layer`) above this theme's `z-index:-1` layer | Fixed in v0.2.2: that layer is hidden while the theme background is active |
| `dsh plugin add` rejected with `Unexpected token '\uFEFF'` | `package.json` was saved with a UTF-8 BOM, which `JSON.parse` rejects | Fixed in v0.2.2; `.gitattributes` keeps it from coming back |
| Viewer text refused to change colour | The plain preview has its own green `#2b8a3e`; a container `color` loses | Fixed: pinned on `pre[class*="_plain"]` (`!important`, plain renderer only) |
| Two themes fight over colours | Both override `--dsw-alias-*`, last one wins | Turn on theme takeover |
| Whole window g

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Known issues & fixes：Full reproduction guide for the "background / blur does nothing" class of bugs: [docs/repro-background-not-changing.md](docs/repro-background-not-changing.md) (English) · [中文版](docs/repro-background-not-changing.zh-CN.md).

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Compatibility：| Item | Notes |
| --- | --- |
| Engine | Chromium 76+ (Edge / Chrome / Electron); older engines lack `backdrop-filter` |
| GPU | With acceleration off, the glass degrades to a flat translucent layer |
| DPI | 100%–200% works; at 125% the 1px borders and 72px avatar read slightly differently |
| OS | Verified on Windows 10/11 and Alibaba Cloud Linux; macOS untested |
| DSH | Verified on 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.0-rc.2; slots/APIs may differ in other versions |
| Fonts | The hero prefers Source Han Serif / STSong, falls back to a system serif |

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · Tests：```powershell
node test/contrast.mjs      # contrast, CSS-only
node test/client.smoke.mjs  # client half with DOM stubs
node test/host.smoke.mjs    # host half, needs assets
```

Baseline: contrast **31/31**, client **130/130**, host **115/115** (host prints `SKIP` when assets are absent).

给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web GUI 换一套「月隐银蓝」毛玻璃皮肤，并附带一个可编辑的哥伦比娅人格。

section: 哥伦比娅主题 · 补丁版

text:
dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · 声明：- **毛玻璃**（`backdrop-filter`）需要 Chromium 76+ / Edge / Chrome。旧内核、关闭硬件加速、部分远程桌面、虚拟机或集成显卡驱动下会退化为一层半透明色块——**看不到模糊**。
- **渐变裁字**（`background-clip:text`）在少数 GPU 驱动上会整行不渲染。项目对 `@supports` 不支持的情况有纯色兜底，但观感不同。
- **深浅色**跟随系统 / Harness 的外观设置（`prefers-color-scheme` 与 `body[data-ds-dark-theme]`），不是插件自己判断的。
- **高 DPI**（125% / 150% / 200% 缩放）下，72px 头像、1px 边框、2px 字距的观感会有差异；截图像素不等于 CSS 像素。
- **广色域屏幕 / 色彩管理**会让 `#78007a` 这类高饱和紫显得更艳或更灰。不同屏幕上，「同一个颜色」本就不相同。
- **字体**：欢迎语优先思源宋体 / 华文宋体，机器上没有就回落到系统衬线，字宽与字距会变。
- **宿主壁纸层**：如果你的 Harness 前端自带一层全屏壁纸（如 `#dsh-wall-layer`，不透明、`z-index:0`），它会盖住本主题 `z-index:-1` 的背景层。自 v0.2.2 起，主题背景启用时会收起那层，切回简约模式自动恢复。
dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · 声明：截图仅供参考，不构成「装完必然长这样」的承诺。

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · 这是什么：一套 DSH 主题插件：换色、换背景、毛玻璃、可编辑人格、表情包约定。
补丁版额外提供：主题主权开关、背景上传、模糊/清晰度滑杆、可改欢迎标题。

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · 相比上游改了什么：| 改动 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **主题主权** | 两套哥伦比娅主题并存时会互相覆盖。打开 → 通过宿主 `pluginManager` 真停用另一套（`dsh-columbina-theme`）；关掉 → 恢复它并收起本主题样式。状态持久化，重启后自动恢复。 |
| **背景图上传** | 面板里选图上传，落进 `Background/` 并自动设为起点；缩略图右上角 `×` 可删（带确认）。重名不覆盖，自动加序号。 |
| **模糊 / 清晰度** | 两条独立滑杆：模糊 0–40px（拖动预览、松手落盘，图层按 `1 + 半径/200` 放大以盖住糊边）；清晰度是色纱浓度的正向表述。 |
| **可改欢迎标题** | 标题存在状态文件里，面板可改。`hero.image` 置空则整块头像不渲染，只留一行字。 |
| **可改欢迎页内容** | 标题 + 多行正文都能在面板里改（v0.3.0）。正文留空则整块不渲染；标题留空回落到内置那一句。 |
| **字体配色** | label token 换成 hyposelen1a 版：浅色 `#78007a`、深色 `#acabf2`，次级/三级按 0.82 / 0.6 透明度派生；欢迎语渐变同步。 |
| **右侧查看区正文色** | 预览器的纯文本块自带绿色（`#2b8a3e`），容器级 `color` 压不住，因此直接钉到 `pre[class*="_plain"]`；语法高亮的行内彩色不受影响。 |
| **头像缓存** | 形象地址带 `?v=<路径>`，避免 `Cache-Control: max-age=300` 在换图后仍显示旧头像。 |
| **宿主壁纸层** | 主题背景启用时收起宿主的全屏壁纸层（`#dsh-wall-layer`），v0.2.2 起。 |
dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · 相比上游改了什么：其余（人格 section、表情包清单、fenced 路由、槽位注册、毛玻璃 CSS）与上游一致。

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · 安装：前置条件：DSH 的 desktop 或 web profile 能正常加载客户端插件。验证于 **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**；Linux 实测 **0.2.0-rc.2** 也正常。

`dsh plugin` 依赖 **pnpm**；若报 `spawn pnpm ENOENT`，先执行 `corepack enable pnpm`。

从 GitHub 安装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:Columbla/dsh-columbina-theme-sn
```

本地目录安装：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add D:\path\to\dsh-columbina-theme-sn
```

装完刷新一次页面（客户端半是页面加载时读的）；改了宿主半要重载插件行或重启 DSH。

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-columbina-theme-sn
```

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · 快速上手：1. 侧边栏底部、设置按钮旁出现「☾ 哥伦比娅」；「设置 → 哥伦比娅 · 主题」是同一份编辑器。
2. 顶部开关：人格 / 主题 / **主题主权** / 表情包 / 主动贴表情 / 防连发。
3. 背景区：上传、选起点、拖模糊与清晰度。
4. 「恢复默认」把默认人格底稿填回编辑框；「重新载入」丢弃未保存的改动。

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · 什么时候生效：| 改什么 | 生效方式 |
| --- | --- |
| 人格 / 开关 / 背景设定（面板保存） | 立刻，下一轮对话 |
| `lib/client.js` | 刷新页面 |
| `lib/index.js`、`cordis.patch.yml` | 重载插件行或重启 |
| `Background/` 增删改名 | 刷新页面 |

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · 状态文件与字段：状态文件默认在 `$DSH_HOME/columbina-theme.json`；没有 `DSH_HOME` 时是 `~/.dsh/columbina-theme.json`。

```json
{
  "persona": "……人格提示词……",
  "enabled": true,
  "theme": true,

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · 状态文件与字段：| 字段 | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `persona` | 人格提示词；空串 = 不注入 |
| `enabled` / `theme` | 人格开关 / 主题开关 |
| `takeover` | `true` 表示停用另一套主题 |
| `stickers` / `proactive` / `noRepeat` | 表情包开关——都是提示词规则，不是消息拦截器 |
| `stickerSize` | 贴图最大边长 48–320px |
| `customStickers` / `stickerOverrides` | 自加条目 / 包内条目的改名与隐藏 |
| `hero.image` | 包内相对路径；**空串不显示头像** |
| `hero.title` | 欢迎页那行字 |
| `hero.body` | 标题下面的多行正文，按 `white-space: pre-wrap` 渲染（上限 2000 字）；空串则整块不显示 |
| `background.dim` | 色纱浓度 0–0.95，越高越淡；面板「清晰度」= `1 - dim` |
| `background.blur` | 模糊半径 0–40px |
| `rev` | 写入版本号，手工改文件记得一起调大 |
dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · 状态文件与字段：写入走「临时文件 + rename」，并带 `rev` 乐观并发：缺 `rev` → 400 `client-outdated`，过期 → 409 `stale`。

dsh-columbina-theme-sn README · 主题主权：两个包都会覆写 `--dsw-alias-*` 并各自铺背景层，只能有一个说话。本版不靠 CSS 抢优先级：

```js
const RIVAL_PACKAGE = 'dsh-columbina-theme'          // 另一套的包名
const manager = ctx.get('pluginManager')
await manager.setPluginEnabled(rival.entryId, !takeover)
```

- 打开 → 另一套在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里写成 `disabled: true`（持久，重启不会自己回来）。
- 关掉 → 恢复 `disabled: false`，同时把本主题的 `theme` 一起关掉，避免「两套都没了」的空窗。
- 宿主启动 1.5 秒后，按状态文件里的 `takeover` 再确认一次。
- 没装另一套、或 profile 里没有 `pluginManager` 时，开关只给一句提示，不会拖垮插件。
